trim_weights_mean_ratio: trim extreme weights by clipping at mean times a specified ratio value
trim_weights_percentile: winsorize weights at specified percentile bounds to reduce extreme outlier influence
default_transformations: generate default quantize and fct_lump transformations for all columns in dataframes
apply_transformations: apply custom or default transformations to dataframe columns and add new computed columns
find_adjustment_method: look up a weighting adjustment function by its string name like ipw or cbps
